title: Midi hems love flats and boots
rule: A midi length stays easy and grounded with a flat shoe or a boot.
body: Ballet flats, loafers or a Chelsea boot let a midi skirt or dress swing naturally. It's relaxed, and it works from day to evening.

title: Give a mini some weight
rule: Chunky shoes or boots balance a short hem.
body: A mini skirt or dress can feel slight on its own. A chunky sneaker or a boot adds weight at the bottom, so the whole outfit feels grounded.

title: Heels with the dressier pieces
rule: Heels belong with pieces at their level, not with joggers.
body: A heel lifts a slip dress or tailored trousers. With very casual pieces it looks out of place; there, flats, boots or a clean sneaker fit better.

title: A dress is a whole outfit
rule: With a dress, the shoes set the mood.
body: Because the dress does the work of two pieces, the shoe decides where it's going: flats for daytime, boots for weather, heels for evening.

title: Crop tops want a high rise
rule: A cropped top over high-rise bottoms raises the waist and lengthens the leg.
body: With low-rise bottoms, a crop leaves a gap that cuts the body in half. A high rise closes it, so the proportions look intentional and legs look longer.
